RWCS_star.weight: W[j]=R_hat[j]*U[j], with urgency applied exactly once
RWCS_star.risk_definition: R_hat[j]=maximum contextual risk mapped to competence j, excluding urgency

target_reached.formula: all theta_star[j,t] >= 0.80 for j with high_risk_related=true

episodes_to_target.formula: first target_reached episode; otherwise episode limit

CER.formula: incorrect fixed-post-test critical items / fixed-post-test critical items

CMR.formula: total missing required PPE selections / total required-PPE opportunities across all fixed-post-test items
